Third-party code used by the stream page. Both are LGPL-3.0-or-later (see COPYING.LESSER).

mse-audio-wrapper 1.4.15  https://github.com/eshaz/mse-audio-wrapper
codec-parser 2.5.0        https://github.com/eshaz/codec-parser

Both files are the jsDelivr "+esm" builds of those npm versions:
https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/mse-audio-wrapper@1.4.15/+esm
https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/codec-parser@2.5.0/+esm

Changes: mse-audio-wrapper's import of codec-parser now points to the local file, and the
source map comments are removed. To replace a library, swap the file in this folder.
